Compute Structural Features for a List of Time Series

Source: R/tsstruct.R
tsstruct.Rd

Apply selected feature functions from the tsstructure package to each time series in a list.

tsstruct(x, features)

Arguments

x

A list of numeric time series.

features

A character vector containing the names of feature functions to compute. Each function must accept a numeric vector as its first argument and return a single value.

Value

A data frame with one row per time series and one column per selected feature, in addition to the series name.

Examples

series <- list(
  linear = 1:20,
  rand = rnorm(100),
  zigzag = c(1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7, 4, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5, 6, 5,6),
  seasonal = sin(2 * pi * (1:100) / 12)
)

tsstruct(
  x = series,
  features = c("max_abs_diff", "sd_diff", "jump_score_sd", 
  "detect_jumps_all", "detect_zigzag", "jump_score_mean", "randomness_ratio_gam",
  "randomness_ratio_loess")
)
